shared_elements: horizontal register or band dividing the composition
band of repeated short parallel/zigzag incisions
justification: Both are shallow, schematic relief carvings on coarse stone organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both include a band of repeated short vertical/zigzag strokes plus an isolated circular disc among creature-like forms. However, A is a massive three-dimensional anthropomorphic statue whose reliefs wrap a modelled body (head, arms, belt), while B is a flat rectangular slab with a friezelike arrangement of arches and animals, so the carving logic, scale relations and subject placement do not correspond beyond generic register-and-band structure.
